verdict.rationale: Better Auth's organization plugin offers member/team permissions management and the admin plugin manages user roles, which provide some coarse-grained authorization scaffolding, but the evidence never describes a relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy-engine system for resource-level authorization beyond roles/teams. missing for 10: explicit policy/ReBAC engine, resource-level permission checks, custom permission statements per resource, independent confirmation of fine-grained authorization use.
